title: Coverage Status of the Retail Pharmacy Network Benefit
content:
**Rule.** The Retail Pharmacy Network Benefit follows the member's Pharmacy Benefit Plan enrollment: it opens with the enrollment, takes effect on its effective date, ends with it, and is restored by a COBRA reinstatement. Member services never opens or ends it on request.

## Statuses

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| Pending effective | The plan enrollment exists but its coverage effective date has not been reached. |
| Active | The plan coverage has taken effect and the member can fill at network pharmacies. |
| Locked in | The controlled-substance safety review has placed the member in pharmacy lock-in. |
| Terminated | Plan coverage ended, or a future-dated enrollment was cancelled before it took effect. |

## Movements between statuses

- Pending effective becomes active when the plan coverage effective date is reached, or terminated when the future-dated enrollment is cancelled.
- Active becomes terminated when plan coverage ends, or locked in when the safety review places the member in lock-in.
- Locked in becomes active when the lock-in period ends or the safety review releases the member, or terminated when plan coverage ends.
- Terminated becomes active on a COBRA reinstatement.

## Claims and paper claims

1. Claims are paid only for dates of service on which the benefit is active or locked in.
2. Claims with a date of service after a retroactive termination are reversed with the reason "retroactive termination".
3. Approved paper claims stay payable after termination.

## Cases (hypothetical)

- A member's coverage was terminated retroactively to the last day of March. A claim dated April 3 is reversed for retroactive termination; a claim dated March 28 is not affected by this clause.
- A member whose benefit terminated last month has an approved paper claim not yet paid. The reimbursement remains payable.
